The depot was Southgate. I've replied to Tobias in a thread in #inc-tansley-carrier-api.

On 2025-09-03, Priyanka posted in that channel that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. When she closed the incident, she wrote that Southgate had cleared the backlog.

Neither the channel nor any file Tobias can see gives a street address or other site details for Southgate. If he needs the address, he'll have to ask Priyanka or the account owner.
